name: Visby class
note: Saab Kockums Visby-class stealth corvette. Primary armament is 8 RBS15 anti-ship missiles plus a 57 mm gun and Torped 45 lightweight torpedoes; a CAMM (Sea Ceptor) air-defence fit is being added from 2026. Sea Giraffe AMB 3D surveillance radar and hull/towed sonar. Displacement/speed/crew below are estimates (specifications table not captured on fetch).

source.title: Radar range not published
source.note: Saab Sea Giraffe AMB 3D PESA surveillance radar; detection range not stated on the page. ~100 km against an aircraft is an estimate. The ship also has hull-mounted and towed-array sonar for subsurface targets.
